name: @storyengine/mode-assistant
description: The assistant — help with the app and your own library, as a mode package, which is 06 §7.4's whole design.
dependencyNote: One dependency, and here it is the claim rather than a convention. 06 §7.4 says that if building the assistant requires a parallel chat implementation, something in the mode contract is wrong — so this package resolving nothing but the SDK is the test, and `tools/repo-shape.test.ts` is what keeps it one.
